stem.en: Chennai gets 128.6 cm of rain a year and Delhi gets 67.0 cm. Chennai's wettest months are October and November. Delhi's are July and August. What do these facts show?

text.en: A yearly total does not show which wind brings the rain, or when

feedback.en: Yes. The two cities get their rain from different winds in different months.

text.en: Every place on the coast gets more rain than every inland place

feedback.en: No. Shillong is inland and gets more than Chennai.

text.en: Delhi and Chennai get their rain from the same wind in the same months

feedback.en: No. Their wettest months are months apart.

text.en: Rain at Chennai falls evenly through the year

feedback.en: No. Just over half falls in two months.

explanation.en: Chennai's main rain comes with the north-east monsoon in October and November. Delhi's comes with the south-west monsoon in July and August. The yearly totals say how much, and hide when and how.

hints.en: Compare the months, not the totals.
Which monsoon blows in October and November?
